theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenVar_measure_le_ofReal_integral_inner_add
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν g : Rn N → Rn N) (C V : Set (Rn N)), MeasurableSet C → MeasurableSet V → C ⊆ V → μ V ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → Continuous g → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ V → g x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ C → inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) = 1) → μ C ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ) + μ (V \ C)
